incident-bot: Pager: SEV2 - embedder tail latency + queue buildup in us-east-1. alert_id=PD-91234. fired 2026-04-02T04:12:11Z

Alex (oncall): taking page, opening live thread. starting root cause checklist.

Jordan (SRE): ack. initial question: errors or just queue/latency?

Alex (oncall): no 5xx spikes, but embedder pod queue depth jumped and 99p token latency hit ~3.1s. Started at ~04:05Z after a config roll at 04:00Z.

Maya (eng): confirmed — KV eviction rate jumped and cache hit ratio dropped from 97% -> 62% post-rollout. roll diff shows small eviction tuning change.

Tariq (Ops): pausing rollout and reverting eviction tuning on canaries now. ETA ~2m for revert.

Alex (oncall): revert done. latency improving in primary AZ, secondary AZ still slow. keeping live page open.

Jordan (SRE): can someone pull customer impact counts? need to know affected tenants and severity for comms.

Maya (eng): rough counts: 9 tenants impacted; 3 high-throughput tenants hit 95p embed latency from 0.5s -> 2.7s. throughput throttling observed.

Sam (PM): tagging for post-incident follow-up. we should create remediation tickets, size them, and mark P0/P1 for sprint planning. also decide comms cadence.

Lee (Product): suggestion: prioritize fix to prevent regressions (deploy guard) and the eviction tuning rollback root cause. fallback routing per-tenant is nice-to-have.

Alex (oncall): creating remediation tasks INF-4456..INF-4460 on the infra board. posting owners + sizes now.

Alex (oncall): Action items:
```
INF-4456 investigate eviction tuning regression & rollback cause - owner: Jordan - size: medium (2.5d)
INF-4457 implement per-tenant graceful fallback when embedder queue exceeds threshold - owner: Maya - size: medium (4d)
INF-4458 add deploy-time canary safety check for eviction config diffs - owner: Alex - size: small (1d)
INF-4459 customer-impact summary + external comms - owner: Sam - size: small (0.5d)
INF-4460 autoscale/burst plan for embedder pool (short-term burst nodes) - owner: Maya - size: large (7d)
```

Jordan (SRE): accepted INF-4456. I'll start with eviction logs, flamegraphs, and canary snapshots. bookmarking relevant traces to the ticket.

Maya (eng): accepted INF-4457 and INF-4460. will prototype fallback logic to reduce cross-tenant impact; will post ETA by EOD.

Sam (PM): prioritization draft:
- P0: INF-4456, INF-4458
- P1: INF-4457, INF-4460
- P2: INF-4459 (comms), but comms should still go out asap.

Lee (Product): agree. tie INF-4460 to Q2 capacity OKR if we think long-term budget is needed. Sam, can you link OKR?

Sam (PM): done — added OKR:infra-stability-Q2 to all tickets.

Tariq (Ops): adding a short-term monitor: alert when eviction_rate > 4x baseline AND cache_hit < 80% so we catch similar regressions.

Jordan (SRE): note for postmortem: capture deploy diff for 03:58-04:02Z window and the canary rollout events. will collect logs and perf snapshots.

Alex (oncall): status: 95p token latency trending down to ~0.9s across most zones. leave live page open until we have postmortem scheduled.

Sam (PM): proposing postmortem: Mon 2026-04-04 09:00 PT (30–45m). Suggested attendees: Jordan, Maya, Alex, Sam, Lee, Tariq. availability?

Jordan (SRE): available.

Maya (eng): available.

Alex (oncall): available.

Lee (Product): available.

Tariq (Ops): available.

Sam (PM): i'll create the calendar invite and attach a preliminary timeline + the INF tickets. owners — please comment on your ticket within 24h to confirm acceptance and add a short plan.

Alex (oncall): confirmed INF-4458.

Jordan (SRE): confirmed INF-4456. started investigation notes in the ticket.

Maya (eng): confirmed INF-4457 & INF-4460; ETA for INF-4457 by EOD.

Sam (PM): customer comms draft posted to INF-4459; sending to affected tenants now.

Lee (Product): quick ask — can we mark INF-4460 as candidate for sprint 2 to ensure budgeting? Sam linked the OKR so should be fine.

Tariq (Ops): suggestion: add a post-deploy checklist step to CI that compares eviction tuning changes to baseline and flags >10% deviation. small effort, big win.

Jordan (SRE): adding rollout diffs and perf artifacts to the postmortem doc.

Alex (oncall): final: pager resolved at 2026-04-02T04:48:10Z (auto-close). leaving remediation tickets open and postmortem on calendar. thanks all.
